**Decision** Do not publish preview theme `77208`. Theme Check passing is not enough evidence for publication. The supplied report only says syntax/static checks passed for the snapshot; it did not include render checks, Theme Editor checks, app-block checks, interaction checks, or live storefront verification. Actual supported state: diagnosis and proposed patch only. No files edited, uploaded, published, live, or verified. **Diagnosis** Observed fact: `templates/product.json` saves three blocks in `sections.details`: - `heading_a`: `type: "heading"` - `care_b`: `type: "accordion"` - `reviews_c`: app block type `shopify://apps/fictional-reviews/...` Observed fact: `sections/product-details.liquid` loops through `section.blocks`, but only renders one case: ```liquid {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% endcase %} ``` Inference: the saved Care accordion disappears because the section schema allows an `accordion` block, and the JSON template contains one, but the Liquid has no `{% when 'accordion' %}` render path. Inference: the saved reviews block disappears because the schema allows `@app`, and the JSON template contains an app block, but the Liquid does not render app blocks with `{% render block %}`. This is a Liquid rendering gap, not evidence of lost Theme Editor configuration. The supplied observation confirms the saved configuration still contains all three blocks in the expected order. **Exact Scoped Repair** Scope: edit only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not touch `templates/product.json`, `config/settings_data.json`, live theme `77200`, app settings, product data, or merchant-authored configuration. Proposed replacement for the block rendering loop: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %} {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %} {% render block %} {% endcase %} {% endfor %}
``` Notes: - `block.shopify_attributes` preserves Theme Editor selection/reorder behavior. - `summary/details` provides native keyboard and disclosure behavior. - `title` is escaped as plain text. - `body` is rendered as richtext because the schema defines it as `richtext`. - `{% render block %}` is the required scoped app-block render path. **Acceptance Checks** Minimum checks before upload or publish: 1. Product preview `77208` renders all saved blocks in order: - heading: “Made for everyday use” - Care accordion - reviews app block container/content, if the app is installed and entitled 2. Care accordion behavior: - closed/open states work with mouse and keyboard - `summary` is focusable - richtext body renders `

` without escaping the paragraph markup 3. Theme Editor behavior: - heading, accordion, and app block can be selected - blocks can be reordered, removed, duplicated, and re-added without losing settings - dynamic editor highlighting still works via `block.shopify_attributes` 4. App compatibility: - review block renders through `{% render block %}` - if reviews still do not appear, separate app entitlement/installation/assets/network errors from theme Liquid behavior 5. Regression scope: - inspect other product templates using `product-details`, if any - confirm no change to unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour review item 6. Validation state: - run Theme Check again - preview representative product pages on mobile and desktop - check console/network for app-block failures where available **Uncertainties** Unknown from the packet: - whether the fictional reviews app is installed and entitled on preview `77208` - whether app assets or network calls fail at render time - whether other product templates use this section - whether the supplied preview snapshot matches the latest local tree **Authorization And Release State** Authorization: diagnosis and proposed patch only. Release state supported by evidence: ```text proposed only -> not edited -> not uploaded -> not published -> not live -> not verified ``` Rollback, if the proposed patch is later applied: revert only the change to `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not roll back unrelated merchant configuration or the pending brand-colour change.
